title: ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SEOUL NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITAL ESTABLISHMENT ACT

ENFORCEMENT DECREE OF THE SEOUL NATIONAL UNIVERSITY DENTAL HOSPITAL ESTABLISHMENT ACT

Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Seoul National University Dental Hospital Establishment Act and matters necessary for its enforcement. <Amended on May 7, 2019>

Article 2 (Registration of Establishment)
(1) The registration of establishment of Seoul National University Dental Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "Dental Hospital") shall be completed within three weeks from the date of authorization of its articles of incorporation.
(2) The matters to be registered upon establishment under paragraph (1) shall be as follows:
1. Purpose;
2. Name;
3. Location of the principal office;
4. Names and addresses of officers;
5. Matters concerning the authority of representation;
6. Method of public announcement.

Article 3 (Registration of Changes)
Where any matter under the subparagraphs of Article 2 (2) changes, the Dental Hospital shall register the change within three weeks.

Article 4 (Accompanying Documents)
An application for registration under Articles 2 (1) and 3 shall be accompanied by the relevant documents according to the following classifications:
1. For registration of establishment under Article 2 (1): The articles of incorporation of the Dental Hospital;
2. For registration of changes under Article 3: Documents proving the changes.

Article 5 (Effect of Registration Other Than Registration of Establishment)
A matter subject to registration other than registration of establishment may not be asserted against a third party until it has been registered.

Article 6 (Duties of the Auditor)
(1) The duties of the auditor shall be as follows:
1. Auditing the status of the Dental Hospital's assets;
2. Auditing accounting and related affairs;
3. Auditing other matters prescribed by the articles of incorporation.
(2) Where an audit reveals any irregularity or deficiency, the auditor shall report that fact to the board of directors and the Minister of Education without delay. <Amended on February 29, 2008; March 23, 2013>
(3) Matters concerning the methods and procedures for performance of the auditor's duties, etc. shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation.

Article 7 (Board of Directors)
(1) The chairperson of the board of directors shall convene meetings of the board of directors and preside over them.
(2) Except as otherwise expressly provided by statutes, regulations, or the articles of incorporation, the board of directors shall adopt resolutions with a majority of the directors in office present and the affirmative vote of a majority of the directors present.
(3) An external person with extensive knowledge and experience in hospital management under Article 8 (2) of the Seoul National University Dental Hospital Establishment Act (hereinafter referred to as the "Act") shall be a person with experience falling under any of the following: <Amended on May 7, 2019>
1. Experience in managing a hospital-level medical institution under Article 3 (2) 3 (b) or (e) of the Medical Service Act (hereinafter referred to as "general hospitals, etc.") for at least three years;
2. Experience in engaging in medical treatment or administrative affairs at general hospitals, etc. for at least 10 years.
(4) The auditor may attend meetings of the board of directors and state opinions.

Article 8 (Acting on Behalf of the Chairperson of the Board of Directors)
Where the chairperson of the board of directors is unable to perform duties for an unavoidable reason, the directors who shall act on behalf of the chairperson, and their order of precedence, shall be as follows: <Amended on December 30, 2025>
1. The Vice Minister of Education;
2. The Vice Minister of Health and Welfare;
3. The Vice Minister of Planning and Budget;
4. The Director of the Dental Hospital (hereinafter referred to as the "Director");
5. The Dean of the College of Dentistry of Seoul National University;
6. The Director of Seoul National University Hospital.

Article 9 (Recommendation of the Director)
(1) Pursuant to Article 10 (3) of the Act, the board of directors shall recommend a person falling under any of the following as the Director: <Amended on May 7, 2019; August 9, 2022>
1. A faculty member of a college of dentistry (including a professional graduate school of dentistry) who has at least 10 years of teaching experience;
2. A medical professional under Article 2 (1) of the Medical Service Act who has at least 10 years of medical experience.
(2) A person recommended as the Director pursuant to paragraph (1) shall submit the following documents to the board of directors, and the chairperson of the board of directors shall submit them to the Minister of Education: <Amended on August 9, 2022>
1. A hospital management plan and annual plans for implementing hospital management;
2. A plan to strengthen the public role of the hospital and annual plans for implementing the strengthening of its public role (each plan shall include a plan for public health and medical services under subparagraph 6 of Article 6 of the Act).

Article 10 (Acting for the Director)
The persons who shall act for the Director pursuant to Article 10 (5) of the Act and their order of precedence shall be as follows:
1. The head of the Clinical Services Department;
2. The head of the Administration Division;
3. The head of the Planning and Coordination Office;
4. The head of the Education and Research Office.

Article 11 (Subordinate Organizational Units)
(1) The Dental Hospital shall have a Clinical Services Department, an Administration Division, a Planning and Coordination Office, and an Education and Research Office under the Director. <Amended 2022.8.9>
(2) The Clinical Services Department shall have 1 department head, the Administration Division shall have 1 division head, and the Planning and Coordination Office and the Education and Research Office shall each have 1 office head; these positions may be held concurrently depending on the circumstances of the Dental Hospital. <Amended 2022.8.9>
(3) The head of the Clinical Services Department shall be appointed by the Director, with the consent of the board of directors, from among faculty members who concurrently perform duties at the Dental Hospital pursuant to Article 13 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as "faculty members holding concurrent positions"). <Amended 2019.5.7>
(4) Matters concerning the allocation of duties among the department, division, and offices under paragraph (1), the composition and allocation of duties of other subordinate organizational units, etc. shall be prescribed by the articles of incorporation. <Added 2022.8.9>

Article 12 (Procedures for Requesting Faculty Members to Hold Concurrent Positions)
To obtain permission for a faculty member to hold a concurrent position under Article 13 (2) of the Act, the Director shall receive an application for a concurrent position from the faculty member concerned and request permission from the President of Seoul National University following deliberation by the personnel committee prescribed in the articles of incorporation.

Article 13 (Duties and Remuneration of Faculty Members Holding Concurrent Positions)
(1) Faculty members holding concurrent positions who are assigned to positions prescribed in Article 11 (1) may be exempted from teaching hours or have their teaching hours reduced, notwithstanding Article 6 of the Enforcement Decree of the Higher Education Act.
(2) Remuneration of faculty members holding concurrent positions shall be paid by their original institution in accordance with the articles of incorporation of Seoul National University, a national university corporation. <Amended 2011.9.6>
(3) The Dental Hospital may pay allowances to faculty members holding concurrent positions in accordance with the articles of incorporation.
(4) Faculty members holding concurrent positions shall comply with the articles of incorporation and various regulations of the Dental Hospital and faithfully perform their duties at the Dental Hospital. <Amended 2019.7.2>

Article 14 (Termination of Concurrent Positions, etc.)
Where a faculty member holding a concurrent position violates Article 13 (4) or falls under any of the subparagraphs of Article 78 (1) of the State Public Officials Act, the Director may, following deliberation by the personnel committee prescribed in the articles of incorporation, suspend some of the duties of the concurrent position or request the President of Seoul National University, a national university corporation, to take appropriate measures, such as termination of the concurrent position. <Amended 2011.9.6>

Article 15 (Requests for Contributions)
Where the Dental Hospital intends to receive contributions pursuant to Article 15 (1) of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Education a request for contributions, together with the following documents, by April 30 each year:
1. A business plan;
2. A projected statement of financial position and a projected income statement;
3. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the request for contributions.

Article 16 (Applications for Disbursement of Contributions)
Where the contents of a request for contributions under Article 15 have been reflected in the government budget, the Dental Hospital shall, when it intends to receive disbursement of the contributions, submit to the Minister of Education an application for disbursement, together with quarterly business plans and quarterly budget execution plans. <Amended 2008.2.29, 2013.3.23>

Article 17 (Requests for Subsidies and Applications for Disbursement)
(1) Where the Dental Hospital intends to receive subsidies pursuant to Article 15 (2) and the proviso of paragraph (3) of that Article of the Act, it shall submit to the Minister of Education, by April 30 each year, a request for subsidies for the following year, classified into subsidies for dental education and research, subsidies for the operation of facilities and equipment, and subsidies for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans, together with the following documents: <Amended 2019.5.7>
1. A dental education plan and a clinical research plan (applicable only where the Dental Hospital intends to receive subsidies for dental education and research);
2. An operation plan for facilities and equipment (applicable only where the Dental Hospital intends to receive subsidies for the operation of facilities and equipment);
3. A plan for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans (applicable only where the Dental Hospital intends to receive subsidies for repayment of principal and interest on foreign loans);
4. A projected income statement;
5. Other documents necessary to clarify the contents of the request for subsidies.
(2) Article 16 shall apply mutatis mutandis to applications for disbursement of subsidies.

Article 18 (Disposition of Surplus)
Where the Dental Hospital has a surplus at the end of each business year, it shall apply the surplus to cover profits and losses carried forward and carry forward the remaining amount to the following year.

Article 19 (Reporting of Business Plans, etc.)
Pursuant to Article 18 of the Act, the Director shall prepare and report a business plan and budget in a manner that shows the anticipated amounts of revenue and expenditure for each business.

Article 20 (Submission of Statements of Settlement of Revenue and Expenditure)
When submitting a statement of settlement of revenue and expenditure to the Minister of Education pursuant to Article 19 of the Act, the Director shall attach the following documents:
1. The statement of financial position and the statement of settlement of income and expenditure for the relevant year;
2. A table comparing the business plan for the relevant year with the results of its implementation;
3. The auditor's audit report.

Article 21 (Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines)

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 18307, March 9, 2004>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on May 30, 2004.

Article 2 (Establishment Costs)
(1) The establishment committee members under Article 2 of the Addenda to the Act may borrow and use funds necessary for establishing the Dental Hospital.
(2) The costs under paragraph (1) shall be borne by the Dental Hospital.

Article 3 (Disbursement of Contributions)
Of the undisbursed amount of contributions to be disbursed to Seoul National University Hospital for fiscal year 2004, the amount corresponding to the Dental Services Department of Seoul National University Hospital shall be disbursed to the Dental Hospital.

Article 4 (Amendments to Other Statutes and Regulations)
(1) The Enforcement Decree of the Seoul National University Hospital Establishment Act is amended as follows:
In Article 10 (1) 1, "College of Medicine or College of Dentistry" shall be replaced by "College of Medicine."
In Article 11, "Deputy Director for Dental Services, Deputy Director for Pediatric Services" shall be replaced by "Deputy Director for Pediatric Services."
In Article 12 (1), "Dental Services Division and Pediatric Services Division" shall be replaced by "Pediatric Services Division"; and in paragraph (2) of that Article, "Clinical Services Division and Dental Services Division" shall be replaced by "Clinical Services Division."
(2) The Decree on Appointment of Educational Public Officials is amended as follows:
In the proviso to Article 7-2 (3), "university hospital director" shall be replaced by "university hospital director and the Director of the Dental Hospital under Article 9 of the Seoul National University Dental Hospital Establishment Act."
